description: Enumerate a domain's subdomains from public Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh, with a Cert Spotter fallback): every hostname that has ever appeared on a certificate for the domain. Passive reconnaissance - no packets are sent to the target. Useful for attack-surface reviews, migration inventories, and finding forgotten test/staging hosts.

domain.description: Bare domain to enumerate, e.g. example.com (no scheme/path)

name: subdomain_discovery
